title: Fabric Data Agent integration with Azure AI Agent Service (Preview)

content.text: We're excited to launch the integration of data agents in Fabric with Azure AI Agent Service from Microsoft Foundry. To get started, see Consume a Fabric Data Agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio (preview). The Fabric data agent SDK is also available in preview.
